description: Change one supplier’s details. Only the fields you pass change; the rest are left alone, and a blank string is ignored rather than blanking the stored value. Renaming is safe — past purchase orders store the id and look the name up. A name already used by another supplier of this company is refused. This does NOT change item costs: those live on the supplier–item link, so use link_supplier_items to re-price.

supplierId.description: Supplier id from get_suppliers — not a name
